description: Publish a user-requested HTTP application from either pilot, including the smaller pilot on its own, at a generated public HTTPS URL. First install and start the application, enable its production authentication and verify its local HTTP port. This publishes the app only; it does not assign a public VM IP or expose database/SSH ports. Responses consume the existing shared 5 GB outgoing account budget. No paid VM is created. Inspect get_private_vps_action until complete and give the returned URL to the user together with their separately obtained SSH command. If installation fails, preserve the VM and give SSH access; do not claim a working URL. Reuse request_key after a timeout. One fixed application port per pilot lifetime; deleting the pilot removes its route.
name: publish_private_vps
title: Publish a pilot application over HTTPS
